1.title: Texas Court Rejects Innocence Finding for Death Row Inmate Melissa Lucio
1.summary: Melissa Lucio’s execution was halted in 2022, but Thursday’s ruling dealt a setback in her effort to prove that she did not kill her 2-year-old daughter.

2.title: As Trump Hosts State Dinner Honoring Xi, See the Menu
2.summary: The White House said that the three-course menu, including sea bass and bok choy, featured American ingredients with a “subtle Chinese influence.”

3.title: Iranian American Group Files Suit Alleging Iran War Is Unconstitutional
3.summary: In a federal lawsuit filed on Thursday, an advocacy group asked a federal judge to declare that the seven-month war in Iran was never declared or authorized by Congress.

4.title: U.N. Live Updates: Netanyahu Lashes Out at Critics and Underscores Threats to Israel
4.summary: In a combative speech, the prime minister defended Israeli military action across the Middle East, and attacked Mayor Zohran Mamdani of New York. Dozens of delegates walked out of the hall as he took the podium.

5.title: Haiti Turns to Roger Stone To Lobby Trump Administration
5.summary: The Haitian government hired Mr. Stone, a confidant of President Trump, weeks after hundreds of thousands of Haitians lost deportation protection. The contract is worth nearly $800,000, a document shows.

6.title: Why Australia chose the world's biggest political stage to reveal OpenAI hack
6.summary: Australia, which has strict social media restrictions and has proposed controls on algorithms and smart glasses, announced the breach at the UN.
